angles.name: More Games Isn't Enough (volume of play as development) — ad copy series #3
angles.mechanism: Games measure the athlete training built; they don't build one. A game is a test, not a teacher — it reveals what's already there, it doesn't add to it. Speed and power get built on purpose in training, or not at all.
angles.emotionalJob: Reframe games as a mirror, not a maker — without criticizing the parent's choices (validate the instinct, then flip it).
angles.voice: Head-coach-to-parent, declarative, metric-driven. No emoji / exclamation / em dash.
